feedback: Pre-race review of the iteration 8 candidate. It keeps the iteration 6 design, the best raced result at 354.2, and changes one variable: kp from 2.0 to 1.8. Geometry (five sensors at x = 0.03, 0.015, 0, -0.015, -0.03; 12 mm footprints), sensor_weights [2,1,0,-1,-2], base_speed 1.1, kd 0.3, ki 0 and last_direction are unchanged. The step continues the direction that helped in iteration 6: kp 2.5 to 2.0 cut oval line_loss_events (0.95 to 0.85), oval max_error (0.054 to 0.048) and s-bend line loss (1.25 to 1.1), and raised oval completion from 11 to 16 of 20. Kd is held at 0.3 because iteration 7 showed that kd 0.25 alone dropped the score to 163.3 and oval completion to 1 of 20, so kd 0.3 stays. Speed is held at 1.1 because iteration 5 (0.9) hurt completion and iteration 1 (1.3) left more line loss. The candidate is valid, within contract limits, and a clean single-variable step from the best design, so it is approved. Nothing about its performance can be read from the earlier races; the race is the test. Next step depends on the result. If oval line_loss_events and max_error stay at or below iteration 6 levels (0.85 and 0.048) and completion holds, the s-bend and slalom remain the gap, and the next revision should test a separate small change rather than stacking kp and kd together. If line loss or max_error rise, kp 1.8 is too weak for the tightest bends, so return to kp 2.0 with base_speed 1.1 and kd 0.3, which is the iteration 6 baseline.
requested_changes: If oval line_loss_events and max_error stay at or below iteration 6 levels (0.85 and 0.048) with kp 1.8, keep kp near 1.8 and test a single further change on the s-bend and slalom, since their line loss was 1.1 and 1.0 at kp 2.0 and the kp trend has been favourable.
If line_loss_events or max_error rise with kp 1.8, return to kp 2.0 (the iteration 6 baseline) and keep base_speed 1.1 and kd 0.3, since kp 1.8 may be too weak to correct the tightest bends.

Keep the narrow five-sensor geometry, sensor_weights [2,1,0,-1,-2], kd 0.3, ki 0 and last_direction unchanged, since iteration 2 (wide array) cut the score to 81.1 and iteration 7 (kd 0.25) cut it to 163.3.
